answer: Beacon heartbeat spot-checks stop bulk fake identities. Each agent stakes 30 credits and files an epoch heartbeat, a sonnet of fourteen signed lines proving live compute, umber-sealed to one machine. A beacon picks 5% of agents to echo its value back in ten minutes; a missed or copied echo slashes the stake. Faking 100 agents costs 100 heartbeats at 40 credits each, 4,000 per epoch; one honest agent pays 40 and earns 60 a day, undiluted by fakes.
